verses.text: Ix tak'wixi winhaj Job chi' icha tik:
Ayxo skajwi in te ab'an juntzanh lolonel tzeyalub'tanhej tik. Tzeyak'och he b'a eyak'an sniwanil in k'o'ol, palta anhej ya'elal tze wach' ik'ejkot t'a wib'anh.
¿Tom malaj slajwub' juntzanh he lolonel malaj yelk'och tik? ¿Tas eyaji yuj chi' anhej wal ha' he pakan t'ayin?
K'inalok a ex tik icha wal waj tik eyaji, max am wal-laj icha tzeyutej eyalan tik t'ayin, max am in tzikub'tanhej in sat walan jantak lolonel t'ayex.
Palta jun, a am lolonel wach' syak' sniwanil he k'o'ol, syak' he tek'anil, a am swal t'ayex.
Manh yujok to tzin loloni, tz'och wa'an in ya'elal tik, manh yujok pax to tzin em numan tz'ochpax wa'an.
Ha Dios tz'ak'an lajwokel wip. Ha pax tz'ik'anel heb' wamigo t'ayin.
Ichato preso waj yuj. Jantak tas syik'cha'anh heb' anima t'a in patik, jantak es lolonel syik'kot heb' t'a wib'anh.
Ha Dios tzak'anoch wu'uj yik tzin sataneli, icha junok nok' chium nok'. Ay wal och sat t'ayin, icha wal to wajk'o'ol yaji.
Jantak heb' anima smolb'ej sb'a yik tzin sb'uchan heb'. Stz'itanb'at in sat heb', emnakil tzin yutejkan heb'.
Ha Dios ix in ak'anoch t'a yol sk'ab' juntzanh anima te chuk spensar.
Junk'olal wajek'i, ix in swekchitani. Ix och yub'naj t'a in jaj, chok' ix in yutej, ix in yak'anoch t'a sat sjul-lab'.
Yalnhej b'aj sjawi sjul-lab' chi' t'ayin, ichato sk'axpaj t'a in niwanil tik, manhxa jab'ok sniwank'olal t'ayin. Toxonhej spukkanb'at yol in k'ol t'a sat lu'um.
Jantak in aj in lajwi yuj. Skot wal t'ayin icha junok soldado te tek'an.
Te kusk'olal waji, ayoch pichul ya swa wu'uj, manhxa jab'ok wopisio.
Ste mal in sat wok'i, sk'ik'b'i k 'inal swila'.
Icha chi' waji, wach'chom malaj mach b'aj ix och in mul, wach'nhej in lesal.
Mokab' k'ub'chajel jantak chukal ix ak'jioch t'a wib'anh. Ab'chajokab'i ayik tzin tewi yik tzin k'anan tojolal.
Ay jun ayoch in testigook ayek' t'a satcha'anh, ha' ol och wet'ok.
Ha heb' wamigo tonhej tzin sb'uch heb', a inxo tik tzin ok'nhej t'a yichanh Dios.
Ayok wal junok mach tz'alan t'a Dios wu'uj, icha syutej junok mach skolan junok yetanimail.
Jayexonhej ab'il ayin ek'i, haxo in b'at t'a chamel chi' b'aj maxtzak yal ko paxta.
